name: codex-toolkit
description: Codex-native prompt-pack build, verification, coverage, and review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Prompt-pack build and verification workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex Toolkit provides Codex-native skills for generating prompt packs from specs, building prompt packs, verifying build completeness, checking wiring and coverage, and reviewing changes.
capabilities: Generate executable prompt packs from specs
Build prompt packs with tests and commits
Verify build completeness, wiring, and coverage
Review local changes for correctness and security
Orchestrate prompt-pack build and verification runs
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $create-prompt-packs to convert the project specs into executable prompt packs.
